entries.name: 16:9 screen size
entries.description: Width and height of a 16:9 TV or monitor from its diagonal in inches, in centimetres and inches.
entries.author: Lemma
examples: how big is a 27 inch tv

entries.name: Appliance running cost
entries.description: Monthly electricity cost of a device from watts, hours per day and price per kWh.
entries.author: Lemma
examples: running cost 150 w 8 hours a day at 0.30 per kwh

entries.name: BMI
entries.description: Body-mass index from weight and height, with the WHO adult category.
entries.author: Lemma

entries.name: Concrete for a slab
entries.description: Concrete volume for a rectangular slab from length and width (m) and thickness (cm), with 10% extra and the approximate weight.
entries.author: Lemma
examples: concrete for 6 m by 2.5 m 15 cm thick

entries.name: Download time
entries.description: How long a download takes from file size (GB) and connection speed (Mbps).
entries.author: Lemma

entries.name: LED resistor
entries.description: Series resistor for an LED from supply voltage, LED forward voltage and current (mA), with the power the resistor must handle. Use the next standard value up.
entries.author: Lemma
examples: resistor for led 12 v supply 3.2 v at 350 ma

entries.name: Paint needed
entries.description: Litres of paint for a wall area, number of coats and coverage per litre.
entries.author: Lemma
examples: paint for 45 m2 2 coats at 12 m2 per litre

entries.name: Recipe scaler
entries.description: Scales an ingredient amount from the servings a recipe makes to the servings you want.
entries.author: Lemma

entries.name: Roman numerals
entries.description: Writes a whole number from 1 to 3999 in Roman numerals. (Example of a sandboxed script extension.)
entries.author: Lemma

entries.name: Running pace
entries.description: Pace per kilometre and average speed from a distance in km and a time in minutes, plus the marathon time at that pace.
entries.author: Lemma

entries.name: Savings goal
entries.description: Monthly deposit needed to reach a savings goal in a number of years at an annual interest rate (compounded monthly, deposits at month end).
entries.author: Lemma

entries.name: Trip fuel cost (metric)
entries.description: Fuel cost of a trip from distance, consumption (L/100 km) and price per litre.
entries.author: Lemma
examples: fuel cost 420 km at 6.5 l/100km 1.85 per litre

entries.name: Trip gas cost (US)
entries.description: Gas cost of a trip from miles, miles per gallon and price per gallon.
entries.author: Lemma
examples: gas cost 300 miles at 28 mpg 3.49 per gallon
